h: Cristiano Ronaldo reportedly scores his 982nd career goal
p: Cristiano Ronaldo has reportedly scored again, taking his career tally to 982 goals. He continues to add to a record that no other player is close to matching. Fans are discussing how near he is to the 1,000 mark.
more: The 1,000-goal milestone is his stated target.
Reaction online has been strong among both fans and critics.
